description: Bending Spoons S.p.A.: annual organic growth, subscription share, equity compensation and the annual split of investing cash flows (2023-2025), and the 2025 pro forma revenue and purchase prices, as stated in the final prospectus (Rule 424(b)(4)) and the Form F-1. Read by code/verify_part2_acquirer.py (checks A17 to A20), which decompresses each raw document, verifies its SHA-256, and finds every figure below in it on the page given (round 3, GLM-F2, GPT-17, DS-67 to DS-69).
units: thousands of US dollars unless stated; shares as fractions
retrieved: 2 Nov 2026, about 23:25 UTC-8, sec.gov, the author's browser (data/v3_inputs/README_retrieval.md section 5)
provenance_note: These figures were first taken from the text extractions in the GLM 5.3 review bundle (notes/reviews/paper1_v3/author_reviews/glm_5_3_high/diagnostics/accounting/bs_424b4.txt and bs_f1.txt, third-party copies, whose 24 overlapping figures the GLM issue log cross-checked against our extract). The lead agent then downloaded the documents from sec.gov; the sources below are those copies, and the GLM texts are no longer an input.

424b4.document: Final prospectus, Rule 424(b)(4), filed 1 Jul 2026, accession 0001104659-26-079884 (cited as bendingspoons2026prospectus)

f1.document: Form F-1, filed 8 Jun 2026, accession 0001104659-26-071170 (cited as bendingspoons2026f1)

page_rule: Printed page number: the last line of the page in the document (pages split at the filing's page-break-after rules). A figure with a page_anchor is read only on pages that also contain that text.

organic_revenue_growth.section: Management's discussion and analysis of financial condition and results of operations; Operating results, Annual, Revenue
organic_revenue_growth.passage: Organic revenue growth[30] was 7% in 2024 ... Organic revenue growth was 13% in 2025
organic_revenue_growth.definition: footnote 30, same page: revenue in the period divided by the revenue (including estimated pre-acquisition revenue, where applicable) generated by the same businesses in the corresponding period of the prior calendar year, minus 1
organic_revenue_growth.definition_regex: defined as our revenue in that period divided by the revenue \(including estimated pre-acquisition revenue, where applicable\) generated by the same businesses
organic_revenue_growth.note: the company's own measure (unaudited operating results); not g^org of Definition 5

subscription_share_of_revenue.section: Prospectus summary, Revenue sources (p. 7); Business, Revenue sources (p. 108 of the 424B4, p. 107 of the F-1)
subscription_share_of_revenue.passage: Subscriptions accounted for 95% of our revenue in 2023, 92% in 2024, and 93% in 2025
regex: Subscriptions accounted for (\d+)% of our revenue in 2023, (\d+)% in 2024, and (\d+)% in 2025
